title: AssetMeasurementBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Envelope for a batch of interval measurement readings (int:AssetMeasurement) for multiple Assets, all belonging to the same Site. Assets are grouped by subtype, mirroring the AssetBatch (registration) schema. Per the ontology workbook, the generic AssetMeasurement sheet is a cross-reference matrix only ('REFER TO EACH ASSET TYPE FOR FIELD DEFINITIONS'); field definitions here are taken from each asset subtype's own MEASUREMENT section, which supersedes the AssetMeasurement sheet. AssetState fields (operational/control state, e.g. stateOfCharge, evConnected, dhwEnabled) are out of scope and are covered by a separate AssetState EWDS Topic schema.

siteId.description: FK to the Site that all Assets in this batch are located at.

items.title: int:BatteryUnit
items.description: Measurement readings for one BatteryUnit within the batch.

assetId.description: FK to the Asset these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for a BatteryUnit (int:AssetMeasurement, BatteryUnit-specific fields).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurement is recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

chargePower.description: Instantaneous power flowing into the battery, in W.

dischargePower.description: Instantaneous power flowing out of the battery, in W.

chargeEnergy.description: Cumulative energy charged into the battery, in kWh.

dischargeEnergy.description: Cumulative energy discharged from the battery, in kWh.

items.title: int:PhotovoltaicUnit
items.description: Measurement readings for one PhotovoltaicUnit within the batch.

assetId.description: FK to the Asset these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for a PhotovoltaicUnit (int:AssetMeasurement, PhotovoltaicUnit-specific fields).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurement is recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

dcPower.description: Instantaneous DC power generated by the PV system, in kW.

dcVoltage.description: Instantaneous DC voltage generated by the PV system, in V.

dcCurrent.description: Instantaneous DC current generated by the PV system, in A.

mppEnergy.description: Energy associated with maximum power point tracking, in kWh.

mppPower.description: Instantaneous power at maximum power point tracking. Should be <= the asset's peakPower, in kW.

energyYield.description: Cumulative or daily PV energy yield, in kWh.

items.title: int:HydroGeneratingUnit
items.description: Measurement readings for one HydroGeneratingUnit within the batch.

assetId.description: FK to the Asset these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for a HydroGeneratingUnit (int:AssetMeasurement, HydroGeneratingUnit-specific fields).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurement is recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

energyYield.description: Cumulative or daily hydro energy yield, in kWh.

items.title: int:EVChargingStation
items.description: Measurement readings for one EVChargingStation within the batch.

assetId.description: FK to the Asset these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for an EVChargingStation (int:AssetMeasurement, EVChargingStation-specific fields). Excludes stateOfCharge and evConnected, which are AssetState fields, not measurements.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurement is recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

power.description: Instantaneous charging/discharging power. Positive = G2V, negative = V2G, in W.

importEnergy.description: Cumulative energy delivered to connected EVs, in Wh.

exportEnergy.description: Cumulative energy returned from EVs (V2G), in Wh.

items.title: int:HeatPump
items.description: Measurement readings for one HeatPump within the batch.

assetId.description: FK to the Asset these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for a HeatPump (int:AssetMeasurement, HeatPump-specific fields). Excludes dhwEnabled, which is an AssetState field, not a measurement.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurement is recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

power.description: Instantaneous electrical power consumption, in W.

cumulativeEnergyConsumed.description: Cumulative electrical energy consumed, in Wh.

items.title: int:ElectricBoiler
items.description: Measurement readings for one ElectricBoiler within the batch.

assetId.description: FK to the Asset these measurements belong to.

items.description: A single interval measurement reading for an ElectricBoiler (int:AssetMeasurement, ElectricBoiler-specific fields).

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the measurement is recorded. ISO 8601 with timezone.

power.description: Instantaneous electrical power consumption, in W.

maxPowerRating.description: Maximum rated electrical power (e.g. 9 kW, 10 kW, 3 kW at LIC sites). NOTE: the ontology workbook lists this under ElectricBoiler's MEASUREMENT section, but it reads as a static nameplate rating rather than a time-series reading; flagged for confirmation, in W.

cumulativeEnergyConsumed.description: Cumulative electrical energy consumed, in Wh.
